create_stochastic_depth_module: create a StochasticDepth module with drop probability p to randomly zero graph node and edge features during training
use_stochastic_depth_2d: use stochastic_depth_2d to randomly drop node feature tensors by probability p using a batch index tensor
use_stochastic_depth_3d: use stochastic_depth_3d to randomly drop edge feature tensors by probability p using a batch index tensor
create_skip_stochastic_depth: create a SkipStochasticDepth module that passes through node and edge features unchanged as a no-op dropout layer
test_stochastic_depth_forward: test the StochasticDepth forward pass by passing node features, edge features, and a node batch tensor
